_note: Definition of the one approved Apple search advert campaign (LOC-664). HELD: nothing is created in any advertising account. Every value is entered by hand by the founder on the start day; see 01-campaign-definition.md. docs/growth-ads-2026-11/ and scripts/growth/appleAdsEntrySheet.cjs read this file; scripts/growth/__tests__/appleAdsCampaign.guard.test.js pins it.
approval: LOC-583 plan, approval 4: Apple search adverts, 60 pounds at most
audience: New users (people who have not downloaded Volyume)
timeZone: Europe/London (the account time zone; Apple fixes it when the account is opened)
bidChangesDuringRun: none, except the one raise to 2.00 allowed in section 5.2 of the definition

keywordSource.rule: every row except the brand control 'volyume'

halfway.trigger: the first read at which Spend (campaign total from the start date) is 30 pounds or more
halfway.readCadence: every morning S+1 to S+29 with the API credential; export dates only without it
halfway.figure: Spend divided by Installs (Tap-Through), campaign totals from the start date, at that read
halfway.noInstallsRule: no installs counts as more than 5 pounds per install (spend is already 30 pounds or more)
halfway.neverReachedRule: if 30 pounds is not reached by the end of day 30 the rule does not apply and does not fire; the day-31 message says so

activation.firesWhen: judged_14_days is at least 10 and three_workouts_in_14_days times 5 is less than judged_14_days
